name: thyroid-lr-v1

training_data.source: De Cassai et al., PLoS ONE 2019 (Padova, thyroid surgery; CC-BY 4.0)
training_data.population: adults scheduled for thyroidectomy, expected difficult intubation excluded

validation.method: stratified 5-fold CV × 20 (nested CV for the penalty)

probast.tool: PROBAST (Wolff et al., Ann Intern Med 2019)

domains.why: Patients with an expected difficult intubation were excluded by protocol: the most obvious cases are missing, and the ability of the predictors to discriminate is distorted (spectrum bias).
domains.applicability_why: Thyroid surgery only (77% women, a quarter with a large goitre), one centre.

domains.why: Measured at the anaesthesia visit, before intubation, with standard definitions.
domains.applicability_why: Almost all the El-Ganzouri items, the same as in the app's form.

domains.why: Cormack with a conventional curved blade, standard definition; the intubating clinician probably knows the pre-operative assessment (not blinded).
domains.applicability_why: Exactly the project's outcome (direct laryngoscopy, Cormack 3–4).

domains.why: 48 events for 7 predictors (about 7 per predictor), below Riley's sample size; Mallampati, neck and history arrive already cut into yes/no. In favour: pre-specified predictors, no missing values, penalization, calibration and optimism measured.

limitations: 48 events: estimates still unstable; sample size below Riley's criteria.
Thyroid surgery only, one centre; patients with an expected difficult intubation excluded.
Mallampati, neck movement and history of difficult intubation available only as yes/no.
Overall risk of bias high (PROBAST). Not externally validated. **Do not use for clinical decisions.**
